IS : 8645 - 1977 



Indian Standard 

DIMENSIONS OF 
MAGNETS FOR ENERGY METERS 



0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution 
on 1 December 1977, after the draft finalized by the Magnetic Components 
and Ferrite Materials Sectional Committee had been approved by the 
Electronics & Telecommunication Division Council. 

0.2 This standard specifies the dimensions of brake magnets used in 

energy meters. 

0.3 While standardizing the sizes of brake magnets for energy meters, it 
is not the intention to prohibit individual manufacturers making special 
sizes against customer's orders. Every attempt should, however, be made 
to choose the sizes from those specified in this standard. 

0.4 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of 
this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, 
expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with 
IS : 2-1960*, The number of significant places retained in the rounded 
off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this 
standard. 



1. SCOPE 



1.1 This standard specifies the dimensions of rectangular, cylindrical and 
U-shape brake magnets used in energy meters. 

2. DIMENSIONS 

2.1 The sizes of brake magnets used in energy meter shall be as given in 
Table 1. 



♦Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ).
